source.source_boundary: Item.NSIMI counts different similar items represented by one item record; they have identical data but cannot replace each other in the system. ItemStructure.QTYPM counts identical interchangeable children per mother. An NSIMI>1 item cannot have subitems. System FRT covers child FRT times ENVF times QTYPM times NSIMI.

delta.paired_mechanism: From subitem-free accepted E01, each branch has two child-rate contributions and System.FRT 600000 and local LRU stock two. Identical branch uses ItemStructure.QTYPM=2 with Item.NSIMI default 1; similar branch uses QTYPM=1 with Item.NSIMI=2. Missions, task durations, seed and 36-hour horizon are inherited.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Each source independently imports, exports and roundtrips every populated author table; native conversion has zero errors, five guarded steps succeed, and report/event log are nonempty.

Both inputs produce effective two-item aircraft material exposure or a native equivalent, with failures, removal/fit tasks, stock issue/return and final report metrics reconciled independently. The native evidence must distinguish identity behavior of identical versus similar items before any claim about non-interchangeability is published.
A source-only distinction may be published only as such if native events do not discriminate the two item classes; stochastic count differences alone do not establish interchangeability semantics.

No missing spare, backorder or cross-item substitution may be silently treated as success. Each branch's source and raw artifacts must be sealed to its own invocation and closure; independent read-only review is required.
limits: One aircraft, one LRU item record, no SRU/subitems, one fixed seed and 36 hours. Similarity group IDs and nested repair chains are separate.

Stock size and system FRT differ from the E01 one-position parent in both branches. Without native discriminating evidence, the manual/source distinction alone does not establish runtime replacement behavior.
